operators.name: expand_mask
semantics: Replicates mask to the target shape (16,3,1024,2048) according to PyTorch broadcast semantics.
Does not copy data if mask already has the target shape, otherwise repeats data as needed.
Returns a contiguous tensor of expanded shape, dtype bool, on CUDA.

operators.name: masked_scatter
semantics: Copies elements from source into input at positions where mask is True, in row-major order of mask.
The number of True elements in mask equals the number of elements in source (both 50,331,648).
Positions where mask is False retain the original input values.
The output tensor has the same shape, dtype, and device as input.
mask is expanded from shape (16,3,1024,2048) to shape (16,3,1024,2048) by broadcasting.
Expansion does not allocate new data if dimensions match, but returns a tensor with the requested shape and stride.
The result is used as the mask argument for masked_scatter.
Scatter values are taken from scatter_values (float32, shape (16,3,1024,1024)) and scattered into positions where mask is True.
The number of True mask values equals the number of elements in scatter_values, so the entire source is used.
Returns a tensor of shape (16,3,1024,2048), dtype float32, on CUDA.
